hero.headline: Kerala's AV and events crew, in one place.
hero.subheadline: CrewHive connects skilled audio-visual and event technicians with production houses, event managers, and agencies across Kerala.
hero.priorityIndustriesTitle: Focused on Kerala's creative & live event industries:

audienceNotice.title: Built for Skilled Technicians
audienceNotice.description: Technicians are the core launch focus of CrewHive. From live sound and concert lighting to cinema camera crews and post-production specialists, our verified platform helps you showcase your craft and get booked.

crewBenefits.title: Why Skilled Technicians Choose CrewHive
crewBenefits.subtitle: Everything you need to showcase your skills, control your schedule, and connect with genuine recruiters.
crewBenefits.disclaimer: CrewHive is a direct discovery platform. We do not promise employment, booking allocation, or fixed income.

items.title: Free Professional Profile

items.description: Choose your primary and secondary roles across sound, lighting, video walls, camera, rigging, and more.

recruiterBenefits.title: Why Recruiters Hire on CrewHive
recruiterBenefits.subtitle: Eliminate endless phone calls and last-minute panic. Discover verified AV talent ready to work across Kerala.
recruiterBenefits.disclaimer: CrewHive provides direct talent discovery. Bookings, commercial agreements, and payouts are handled directly between recruiters and crew.

rolesShowcase.title: Professional Role Categories
rolesShowcase.subtitle: Covering the complete technical ecosystem of live events, broadcast, cinema, and media production in Kerala.

categories.name: Lighting
categories.description: Console operators, gaffers, moving head specialists, dimmer technicians, and stage illumination experts.

categories.name: Sound
categories.description: FOH engineers, monitor engineers, RF technicians, line array system engineers, and audio patch crew.

categories.name: Rigging & Staging
categories.description: Truss riggers, motor operators, stage supervisors, structural technicians, and safety coordinators.

categories.name: SFX
categories.description: Stage pyrotechnicians, cold spark operators, CO2 jet handlers, flame effects, and atmospheric haze crews.

categories.name: Camera
categories.description: Cinematographers, multi-cam live broadcast operators, focus pullers, gimbal technicians, and jib operators.

categories.name: Direction & Production
categories.description: Production managers, floor managers, technical directors, assistant directors, and cue callers.

categories.name: Art & Set
categories.description: Set designers, scenic fabricators, backdrop dressers, prop masters, and exhibition carpenters.

categories.name: Photo & Video
categories.description: Event videographers, commercial photographers, drone operators, and live feed capture specialists.

categories.name: Post Production
categories.description: Offline/online video editors, color grading artists, audio mastering technicians, and motion designers.

categories.name: LED & Video Walls
categories.description: LED wall engineers, Novastar/Brompton processor techs, video switchers, and projection mapping operators.

founderNote.title: A Note from the Founder
founderNote.message: CrewHive was conceived to bring structure, transparency, and dignity to the dedicated technicians who power Kerala's vibrant audio-visual, film, and live events sector. Ahead of our January 1, 2027 official launch, we are working closely with industry associations, technical veterans, and production houses to ensure this platform serves the genuine interests of our working crew. The full founder address and roadmap will be shared here in the upcoming milestones.
